model: known-density flat 2+1 Minkowski, complete exact causal order

selection.rule: retain old selected root, support and first three landmarks on A; select the fourth using A only, minimum inherited full16/half4 counts and causal comparability to all required endpoints; minimize difference-Gram condition, marks break ties; no retries using B

count_covariance: intersection counts for every pair of measured intervals, including shared landmark/root intervals; conditional on A, unbiased estimate of rho_B times overlap volume
propagation: first-order delta transform N to squared proper times, then differentiate full constrained KKT solve; all off-diagonals retained; approximate, not exact geometry covariance
negative_control: replace interval-count covariance by its diagonal before propagation
comparison: four-landmark B versus three-landmark B using identical A support and same independent B sample; original three-landmark A and true-coordinate Oracle are diagnostics
qualification: correct signature, bounded moment condition, KKT certificate and exact observed order on all four landmarks plus root and supports
gate_scope: bounded prospective pilot; point-estimate engineering gates, not a population theorem; report qualified subset separately and all failures; all gates required for PILOT_SUPPORTED
freeze: local code/input hash and UTC timestamp before first new A or B cloud
